issues.description: The StockIngredient constructor signature differs between the problem statement/UML and the template repository. The UML and solution use StockIngredient(String, int, int) but the template's StockIngredient class only provides StockIngredient(String, int, int, boolean). Students following the UML or the solution example (e.g., calling new StockIngredient(name, price, quantity)) will get a compile error because the 3-argument constructor is missing in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a StockIngredient(String, int, int) constructor in the template (either by adding an overloaded 3-arg constructor that delegates to the existing 4-arg constructor or by changing the existing constructor to match the 3-arg signature). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to require the 4-arg constructor with a boolean if that was intended.
